name: token-auto-release

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan

description: Taking the keyboard back and giving it up again (C2 decision 6; 5.53; D31, D32): a handoff moves the control token — the frame that moves it is one of handoff (to a client_id, to null to revoke to escrow) or an owner's handoff to itself — and, when the auto-release knob is above 0, the token returns to the client that held it before the take-over N seconds after the owner's last keystroke, with reason release. With the knob 0 it never returns by itself; 0 is the default and a config.yaml knob, never a schema default. Every token move is a session.control audit event. The live shapes are graded by U2 (owed by the E2 core plan).

instances.note: the holder hands the token to another attached client
revoke to escrow: the owner reassigns later, an attach does not take it
the owner's explicit take-over: to its own client_id
to is required, and null is its revoke form
to is a client_id or null, never a number
auto-release returned the token to the previous holder
the token went to the owner per taking the keyboard back
a revoke to escrow: holder is null, reason owner (the owner revoked it)
the reason is release, one spelling (F17)
